test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man wanted to sell an item at 25% profit, but he actually sold it at 25% loss for Rs. 870. At what price did he want to sell it to earn the profit of 25%?
solution:
**Given:** 

SP = Rs. 870 

Loss = 25%

**Formula used:**

** CP = (100)/((100 - Loss\%))times SP**

SP = ((100+Gain\%))/(100)times CP

**Calculation:**

**CP = (100)/((100 - Loss\%))times SP**

⇒ ** (100)/((100 - 25))times 870**

⇒** (100)/(75)times 870**

**CP = Rs.1160**

According to the question

New selling price,

SP = ((100+Gain\%))/(100)times CP

⇒ ((100+25))/(100)times 1160

⇒ (125)/(100)times 1160

**∴ The Sales price of the items is Rs. 1450**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Given:

SP₁ = Rs. 870

Loss = 25%

Gain = 25%

SP₂ = ((100+Gain\%))/((100-Loss\%))times SP₁ 

⇒ ((100+25))/((100-25))times 870 

⇒ (125)/(75)times 870 

**∴ The sales price of the items is Rs. 1450**
